clue.text: Moobs pert when naked in English city

parts.note: slang for fleshy breasts on a man, read here as a man's chest

indicators.note: naked means stripped of its covering, so the outer letters of pert are removed

explanation.surface: A cheeky remark about a bare-chested man out and about in an English city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when naked' strips the outside letters from 'pert', leaving ER. 'Moobs' (man boobs) is read playfully as MAN CHEST.
explanation.definitionFit: Manchester is a major city in north-west England, so it is an example of an English city.

clue.text: Fine Greek character left court

parts.note: mu is the twelfth letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek character is penalised for walking out of court.
explanation.definitionFit: To mulct is an old legal verb meaning to punish with a monetary penalty, a synonym of the verb fine.

clue.text: Dump right-hand man

definitions.meaning: a childish euphemism for a bowel movement
a deputy or chief assistant, second in command

explanation.surface: A boss disparaging a trusted deputy.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both nursery slang for defecation and the term for a second in command.

clue.text: The anxious hate unusual medical condition

indicators.note: unusual tells us the letters appear in an out-of-the-ordinary order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Nervous people whose strange loathing makes them ill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' signals the anagram of all fourteen letters of 'The anxious hate'.
explanation.definitionFit: Overheating that leaves the body dizzy, sweating and weak is a recognised illness, an example of a medical condition.

clue.text: Large top quality mushrooms served up as dish of the day?

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means the letters are presented bottom to top, i.e. read backwards

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
A1 means first-rate, written here as AI
ceps are porcini mushrooms

explanation.surface: A restaurant offering big, first-rate mushrooms as its featured menu item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top quality' is A1, written with the figure as the letter I. 'served up' turns L + AI + CEPS upwards in the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A restaurant's dish of the day is called its special, a common menu term.

clue.text: Body part subsequently formed from clay

parts.note: the ear is a part of the body
then means afterwards, subsequently

explanation.surface: A sculptor shaping a body part first, then more from clay.
explanation.definitionFit: Earthen pots are made of baked earth or clay, so the adjective describes something fashioned from clay.

clue.text: Multiple-choice featuring e) In the Navy?

indicators.note: featuring means the word contains the answer within its letters

explanation.surface: A quiz question whose option e) is the Village People song In the Navy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'featuring' points into multiplE-CHOice. The definition plays on the radio phonetic alphabet used by navies.
explanation.definitionFit: In the NATO phonetic alphabet used for naval radio, the letter E is spoken as this code word.

clue.text: Person in charge has love for a singing group

indicators.note: has love for a means the letter O takes the place of the letter A

parts.note: a chair is the person presiding over a meeting
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A conductor who adores a vocal ensemble.
explanation.definitionFit: A choir is an organised body of singers, so a singing group by definition.

clue.text: Queen leaving presents with each male child in time of low-spending

indicators.note: leaving means the Queen's letters depart from the word for presents

parts.note: offers as a verb means presents or puts forward
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword Queen
a son is a male child

explanation.surface: A royal leaves gifts for every boy during an economically quiet period.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' removes ER from OFFERS, giving OFFS.
explanation.definitionFit: In tourism and retail the slack part of the year, when customers spend little, is called the off-season.

clue.text: Harry Belafonte gains appreciation of others' interests, at great personal cost

definitions.text: appreciation of others' interests, at great personal cost

indicators.note: to harry is to harass or disturb, so these letters are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: The singer Harry Belafonte is praised for selflessly championing others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Harry' looks like Belafonte's first name but is the anagram signal on 'Belafonte gains'.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-denial means putting others' needs first at one's own expense, which the long definitional phrase describes.

clue.text: Tell fib about drink to get another

indicators.note: about means the first word goes around the second

parts.note: to lie is to tell a fib
mead is a drink made from honey

explanation.surface: Fibbing about what you've drunk in order to get a refill.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition 'another' leans on 'drink' earlier in the clue: the answer is another drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A citrus soft drink is a beverage different from the mead in the wordplay, hence a further drink.

clue.text: Recite list of bad news to an angler?

definitions.meaning: to rattle off a sequence of items from memory
a fishing reel coming off the rod would be unwelcome to someone fishing

explanation.surface: Someone reading out a catalogue of misfortunes to a fisherman.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to recite fluently, and literally describes a fishing spool detaching.

clue.text: Immediately after that, he threw it out

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are thrown out of order, wrong and needing rearrangement

explanation.surface: Straight afterwards, he flung it away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' signals the anagram of 'he threw it'.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned adverb meaning at once or thereupon, i.e. straight after something.

clue.text: Play with boobs?

parts.note: boobs are blunders; a comic stage play full of absurd mishaps fits, while the surface suggests something saucier

explanation.surface: A cheeky invitation to fondle breasts.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of comedy is built on improbable situations and blunders, so it is a drama full of mistakes.

clue.text: Dump date before long

parts.note: to itch is to long for something

explanation.surface: Ending a relationship before it drags on too long.
explanation.definitionFit: To ditch is informal for discarding or abandoning, a synonym of the verb dump.

clue.text: Tyrannical leaders overheard Richard, Duke of York, and King Edward, perhaps

indicators.note: overheard means we take what the words sound like rather than how they are spelt

parts.words: Richard, Duke of York, and King Edward, perhaps
parts.note: Dick is short for Richard; Duke of York and King Edward are potato varieties, i.e. taters

explanation.surface: A list of English royals who ruled harshly.
explanation.walkthrough: The royal names mislead: Duke of York and King Edward are British potato varieties ('taters' is slang for potatoes), and Richard is DICK. 'overheard' makes DICK TATERS a sound-alike.
explanation.definitionFit: Dictators are absolute rulers who often govern harshly, so tyrannical leaders is a fair synonym.

clue.text: Go on salt concoction to restrict opening of blood vessels

indicators.note: to restrict means the mixed letters hem in the single letter
a concoction is a mixture, so these letters are blended into a new order
opening of means take the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Salt applied to an opened blood vessel to stem it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concoction' rearranges 'Go on salt'; 'opening of' gives B, which that anagram encloses ('to restrict'). 'blood vessels' looks like a phrase but splits.
explanation.definitionFit: Longboats are large rowing boats, such as Viking ships, so they are examples of vessels.

clue.text: Retires and relaxes, holding detectives up

indicators.note: holding means the first word contains the second

parts.note: abates means eases or lessens

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: the CID is the British police Criminal Investigation Department

explanation.surface: Someone retiring and taking it easy while detectives hold them up.
explanation.walkthrough: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police; 'up' reads it bottom to top in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch who abdicates gives up the throne, a formal way of stepping down or retiring.

clue.text: Game, with the skin, that is fried in breadcrumbs

parts.note: croquet is a lawn game played with mallets and hoops

indicators.note: the skin of a word is its outermost letters

explanation.surface: Game meat cooked with its skin on and fried in a breadcrumb coating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skin' takes the outside letters of 'the', TE. 'Game' suggests meat but is CROQUET.
explanation.definitionFit: A croquette is a small roll of mashed food coated in crumbs and deep-fried, matching the definition.

clue.text: Hypothetical particle recreated on yacht

indicators.note: recreated means made again in a different form, so these letters are rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A physicist's theoretical particle rebuilt during a sailing trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A tachyon is a theorised particle travelling faster than light, never observed, so hypothetical.

clue.text: Near a chemist's, showing sign of infection?

indicators.note: showing means the letters are on display within the words

explanation.surface: Close to a pharmacy, revealing symptoms of an illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showing' points to the letters inside nEAR A CHEmist's.
explanation.definitionFit: Pain in the ear often accompanies an ear infection, so it can be a symptom of one.

clue.text: Arrangement by mafia boss following opponents

indicators.note: following means the mafia boss comes after the opponents

parts.note: in bridge East and North play as opponents, E and N
a don is a Mafia leader

explanation.surface: A mafia chief making a deal after his rivals.
explanation.walkthrough: E and N are bridge players sitting on opposing sides.
explanation.definitionFit: End-on describes an arrangement where objects face each other end to end, a positional layout.

clue.text: Partners excluded from a naturist survey

indicators.note: excluded from means these letters are taken out of the longer word

parts.note: a nudist is a naturist
North and South are bridge partners, N and S

explanation.surface: A couple barred from a nudist's questionnaire.
explanation.walkthrough: N and S, a bridge partnership, are removed from A NUDIST.
explanation.definitionFit: An audit is a formal inspection or review of accounts, so a survey in the sense of examination.

clue.text: I love abandoning scene in play

indicators.note: abandoning means these letters are left behind and taken out

parts.note: a diorama is a three-dimensional model scene
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone deciding their love must walk out of a scene in a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoning' removes I and O from DIORAMA.
explanation.definitionFit: A drama is a work for performance on stage, a synonym of a play.

clue.text: Dish of fish and chips cooked in oil, primarily

parts.note: carp is a freshwater fish

indicators.note: primarily means take the first letter of each of the preceding words

explanation.surface: A chip-shop meal of fried fish and chips.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primarily' takes the initials of 'and chips cooked in oil', ACCIO.
explanation.definitionFit: Carpaccio is an Italian dish of thinly sliced raw meat or fish, served as a starter.

clue.text: Iris's gold braids oddly discarded

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters are thrown away, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A woman named Iris losing her golden plaits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Iris's' reads as 'Iris is'. 'oddly discarded' keeps the even letters of 'braids', RIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Orris is a kind of iris whose fragrant root is used in perfumery, so it is an example of the flower.

clue.text: Rita's Conservative rhetoric

parts.note: Rita Ora is a British pop singer, so Rita's surname is Ora
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A woman named Rita giving a Tory political speech.
explanation.walkthrough: Rita Ora is a British pop singer, so 'Rita's' is ORA.
explanation.definitionFit: Oratory is the art of public speaking, essentially a synonym of rhetoric.

clue.text: Animal waste dumps force Conservative to be upfront

indicators.note: to be upfront means the Conservative letter is placed at the front
dumps means this letter is thrown out of the word

parts.note: to fritter is to waste
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: An animal-waste dump forces the Tory government to be frank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dumps' removes F from FRITTER; C goes in front, 'to be upfront'.
explanation.definitionFit: Critter is a folksy North American variant of creature, used for any animal.

clue.text: Sleeps around for a while

indicators.note: around means the word is turned round to read backwards

parts.note: naps are short sleeps

explanation.surface: Someone who dozes on and off for some time.
explanation.definitionFit: A span is a stretch of time, so it means a period or a while.

clue.text: Doctors, medical graduates, nurses: Philistines essentially

indicators.note: nurses means holds or cradles, so the first word contains the second

parts.note: interns are recently qualified doctors in hospital training

indicators.note: essentially means keep only the core of the word, dropping its outer letters on both sides

explanation.surface: A list of hospital staff dismissed as uncultured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nurses' poses as more hospital staff in the list but is the containment signal; 'essentially' keeps the central IST of 'Philistines'.
explanation.definitionFit: Internists are physicians specialising in internal medicine, so they are doctors.
